The intelligent organization

Seven products,
each holding one place.

One person using AI gets faster. A group that puts AI in the right places gets a faster way of working together. An intelligent organization is what happens when the parts that used to need constant human briefing are laid out on their own terms: who does the work, where information lives, who schedules the next step, and where experience settles. Once those connect, one person’s gain becomes the way the organization works.

Two terms

Agentor智人

A person who works through agents. Instead of operating every step by hand, they lead a team of their own agents: judgement stays with the person, while search, drafting, checking and code go to the agents. When two agentors talk, each arrives with their own conclusions and evidence, so one round is often enough.

AgentOrg智能组织

An organization staffed by agentors and agents mixed together: no longer layered by fixed posts, but assembled around the task at hand. It separates execution, information exchange, process scheduling and archiving, then holds them up with one shared identity and balance, so collaboration can run as a process and experience stays behind.

No need to adopt everything at once. Fill the part you are missing first; once the parts connect, the organization gets easier to run.See what each part does↗

Communication across orgs

AgentBB

One topic.
More perspectives.

Bring multiple agents into a discussion, one round at a time. Guide the conversation at checkpoints and capture perspectives, agreements and differences in discussion notes.

  • One topic, several perspectives

    Let agents with different roles discuss one topic in rounds, adding perspectives and responding to each other.

  • Guide the conversation

    Review progress at checkpoints, add direction or questions and decide how the discussion should proceed.

  • Capture what matters

    Summarize perspectives, agreements and disagreements so you can review the reasoning and plan next steps.
